structure: For person i and visit t, (X_it,Y_it) = measurement_mean + S_i + E_it. The stable vector S_i has the between-person covariance, and each mean-zero deviation vector E_it has the within-person covariance. The three vectors are mutually independent, and persons are independent. Gaussian shapes complete the generator but are unnecessary for identifying the requested Pearson correlations.

parameter_provenance.basis: Reported measurement means; visit deviations have zero means.
Pearson correlation of stable X and Y components.
Pearson correlation of X and Y at the same visit.
Each measurement has variance 4+1=5. Same-visit cross-covariance is 0.52*5=2.6, so deviation cross-covariance is 2.6-3.2=-0.6.

parameter_provenance.value: Stable and deviation vectors are independent; deviations at different visits and different persons are independent.

parameter_provenance.basis: Chosen distributional shape for executable sampling; not required by the records or by the correlation derivations.

requested_estimands.name: change_correlation
requested_estimands.basis: Stable components cancel in changes. Independent visits give change variances 2 and change cross-covariance 2*(-0.6)=-1.2; correlation is -1.2/sqrt(2*2)=-0.6.

requested_estimands.name: same_visit_correlation
requested_estimands.basis: Directly reported in B and reproduced by 2.6/sqrt(5*5)=0.52.

requested_estimands.name: cross_visit_correlation
requested_estimands.basis: Only stable components contribute to Cov(X_visit1,Y_visit2), giving covariance 3.2 and correlation 3.2/sqrt(5*5)=0.64.

limitations: This is an artificial mathematical population, not a clinical model or biomedical validation.
Gaussian distributional shape is an assumption; higher-order features are not determined by the records.
The supplied variance decomposition implies measurement variance 5 despite the standardized-units label; the generator does not impose unit marginal variance.
Finite random samples will not exactly match the population moments. No sample-dependent calibration, selection, or seed search is used.
checks_actually_performed: Algebraically reconciled stable cross-covariance 3.2, deviation cross-covariance -0.6, and same-visit cross-covariance 2.6.
Analytically checked positive definiteness: between-covariance eigenvalues are 0.8 and 7.2; within-covariance eigenvalues are 0.4 and 1.6.
Derived all three requested correlations using covariance addition, independence, and cancellation of stable components in changes.
Generator code has not been executed; no empirical sample checks are claimed.
